stories.title: ‘Unfortunate reality’: Some aspiring teachers see waning path to dream job
stories.summary: CCSD is hiring fewer new teachers to fill a shrinking number of classroom teaching jobs, and schools in the State Public Charter School Authority aren’t hiring as many teachers as CCSD is losing.

stories.title: Major casino operator severs ties with problem gambling group over Kalshi membership
stories.summary: One of the Strip’s largest casino operators and its co-owned online sportsbook brand have severed ties with a national advocacy group over the latter’s association with prediction markets.
